people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
translations.bsb: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him,
translations.kjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed
translations.asv: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold. And Jehovah blessed him.
